description: This file contains utility functions for FastAPI, including model field creation, ID generation, and response handling.

methods.name: is_body_allowed_for_status_code
methods.description: Determines if a response body is allowed for a given HTTP status code.

methods.name: get_path_param_names
methods.description: Extracts path parameter names from a URL path string.

methods.name: create_model_field
methods.description: Creates a Pydantic ModelField with validation and configuration.

methods.name: create_cloned_field
methods.description: Returns a cloned version of a ModelField (currently a no-op).

methods.name: generate_operation_id_for_path
methods.description: Generates a deprecated operation ID string based on name, path, and method.

methods.name: generate_unique_id
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for an API route based on its name, path, and method.

methods.name: deep_dict_update
methods.description: Recursively updates a dictionary with another dictionary.

methods.name: get_value_or_default
methods.description: Returns the first non-DefaultPlaceholder item from given items based on priority.
